title: Neither Day Nor Night
subtitle: At every night before the inevitable breaking of dawn, we have to face an ending of this sort.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: It's about to collapse! Got to go now.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Kumar! KUMAR!!
She extends her arm as far as possible, reaching for that figure.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Ah!
A giant rock falls between them. Kumar is lost in her sight.
The shabby basement has completely collapsed. Moonlight floats down through the ceiling that no longer exists.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: *coughs*

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Mr. Shamane, you covered me.
He pats the dust off his shoulder.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: I'm fine.
He looks in the other direction.
Kaalaa Baunaa follows his gaze and sees Kumar.

items.speaker: Kumar
items.text: Pretty ...
The ragged woman with gray hair looks up slowly at the night sky.
Several meteors are crossing the sky with glaring tails.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Her Realm has gone, taking that falling star with it.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Tonight, only the meteor shower will sparkle in the sky.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Kumar. Kumar!
Kaalaa Baunaa, who is now also ragged, staggers toward the one staring at the night sky.
She's haunted by an ominous feeling.
Faster, even faster, get to her side like she used to ...

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Kumar.
Finally, Kaalaa Baunaa holds Kumar's hands.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: I'm still here, Kumar. How about we ... go back first?

items.speaker: Kumar
items.text: Go back?

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Yes, go back to the institution, to the university ...
She cannot continue.

items.speaker: Kumar
items.text: It seems Kumar can no longer understand her words. She just frowns and stares at her in confusion.

items.speaker: Kumar
items.text: Suddenly, she relaxes her eyebrows and smiles while shaking her head.

items.speaker: Kumar
items.text: There's no place I can go back to.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Yes, there is! You can stay at my place. You can use my lab. We can start over.

items.speaker: Kumar
items.text: Sure.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Really? You will? Let's go then! Leave this place first.
Kaalaa Baunaa gets up quickly and holds Kumar's arm in hers. She drags Kumar to leave, seemingly afraid that Kumar may change her mind.

items.speaker: Kumar
items.text: But there are some papers I need to take with me. Let go of my arm.
Says Kumar behind Kaalaa Baunaa. She sounds quite relaxed.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Okay.
Somehow, Kaalaa Baunaa dares not look back. She can only look up at Shamane's face.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Mr. Sharma, Kumar says she'll come with us! She just needs to take some papers. It won't take long!

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: He slowly shakes his head.
Shamane never feels this calm. He looks at his sister, but he feels he is looking at someone else.
He is looking at a weary soul waiting for her final salvation.
She is his last kin.
And he is going to respect her decision.

items.speaker: Kumar
items.text: "Then there was neither death nor immortality; there was neither day nor night."

items.speaker: Kumar
items.text: Everyone has a place to go back to. What a nice world to live in.
Kumar is familiar with the space, even if it's a ruin now. She reaches a corner and takes out a black gadget.
It is the only item she has ever asked from Manus Vindictae.
And now, for the second and the last time, she places her hand on it.

items.speaker: Kumar
items.text: I hope ... when the universe constructs me for a second time, I will not come to this world again.
Bang!
Chandigarh Night Market

items.speaker: Ajar
items.text: Wow! So this is what Chandigarh look like! It slay!

items.speaker: Passerby
items.text: What's this? Candy?

items.speaker: Ajar
items.text: This way. Come over here.
The once rugged paths have been turned into smooth roads. In this new city, the villagers still carry on their old customs.
Candles have lit up every street for the new immigrants on this spring night.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Ah. So you're only an assistant! No wonder they made you go through so many procedures earlier.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Haha. What? So you is just rookie?

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Shut up! I won't allow another word of it! Humph, you'd better be careful; otherwise, you will regret your doings when you get to the Foundation!

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Heh heh.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Did you just make a face to me? Stop right there!

items.speaker: Foundation Member
items.text: Ms. Sherjah and Mr. Sharma.

items.speaker: Foundation Member
items.text: Thank you so much for helping our staff.

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: Emm, you flattered me. I just did what I could.

items.speaker: Foundation Member
items.text: No, madam, we've ascertained your achievement.

items.speaker: Foundation Member
items.text: Before this incident, you volunteered to help over 10 arcanists and human children, and this time you rescued more than 30 arcanists.

items.speaker: Foundation Member
items.text: That's remarkable, madam.
The woman in the Foundation uniform seems to be smiling at Sherjah and passes over a gray envelope.

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: What's this ...

items.speaker: Foundation Member
items.text: A letter of introduction to the St. Pavlov Foundation.

items.speaker: Foundation Member
items.text: I'm sure you know our branch in Chandigarh is already under construction. Such a responsible and caring human member like you will be very welcome.

items.speaker: Foundation Member
items.text: Please do consider this opportunity.
The Foundation member rummages through the materials in her hand.

items.speaker: Foundation Member
items.text: According to the record, there's one more arcanist who also provided help for us in this mission.

items.speaker: Foundation Member
items.text: So, where is Ms. Kaalaa Baunaa?

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: Oh, she's ...
Sherjah turns around. Kanjira is gone too.

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: That's weird.

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: Oh!
She suddenly realizes something.

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: I think it's not a good time for her.

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: They will be back after the meteor shower.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Ah! Meteor shower! So many of they as the news mention!

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Hmm. I wish I can have my stomach full every day when I go school!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Let me be an investigator, even for once!

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Alright, people, don't be greedy! One wish only!

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Goodbye, Kumar.
